name: Kursk Open 2018
information: Registration will be closed at midnight on August, 22 or when we reach 70 competitors. Spectators are welcome and do not need to register or pay. Registration fee: * **100 RUB (~2 USD)** for any one event (for ex. 3x3x3 Cube only); * **200 RUB (~4 USD)** for any 2-3 events; * **300 RUB (~6 USD)** for any 4 events and more; If you do not see your name on the compeitors table after 48 hours of registering, please [contact us](mailto:g.sloboda@mail.ru,Lexkov27@gmail.com) to resolve the issue. Visit the competition [website](https://vk.com/kurskopen2018) for more details.
